external_entities.name: Member
external_entities.description: A library member who uses the library app and self-service kiosks to borrow, renew, reserve, and return books.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

external_entities.name: Desk staff
external_entities.description: Library desk staff who use the circulation page to change loan and member account records.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand
external_entities.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login for the circulation page. The password is on a card taped under the desk.

processes.name: Library app
processes.description: The app on a member's phone that submits borrowing, renewal, and reservation requests to the lending API.
processes.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

processes.name: Self-service kiosk
processes.description: A branch kiosk where members scan their library card and books for loans and returns.
processes.source_excerpt: Every branch has self-service kiosks where a member scans their library card and the books they are borrowing or returning.

processes.name: Lending API
processes.description: The REST API that is the only component described as reading or writing the loans database and that handles lending operations.
processes.source_excerpt: It's a REST API. JSON in, JSON out.
processes.notes: The sources disagree about exposure. Lending service note: "The lending API is internal-only." Interview transcript: "The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet." Authentication for phone calls is also unresolved: Priya said, "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look."

data_stores.name: Loans database
data_stores.description: The single database containing members, loans, reservations, names, email addresses, home addresses, and members' full borrowing histories.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database.
data_stores.notes: Priya corrected the earlier description of two databases: "We merged those in the spring. It's one loans database now. The old reservations database is gone."

data_flows.name: borrow renew reserve
data_flows.description: A member uses the library app to borrow, renew, or reserve a book.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.
data_flows.data_description: Book and member details, borrowing, renewal, and reservation requests

data_flows.name: submit loan changes
data_flows.description: The library app calls the lending API with borrowing, renewal, and reservation requests.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API. It says which book and which member, and the API checks the loan rules and writes the change.
data_flows.notes: Authentication is unknown. Priya said: "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look."
data_flows.data_description: The selected book or title, member identity, and loan or reservation change

data_flows.name: send loan return
data_flows.description: A self-service kiosk sends each scanned loan and return to the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.
data_flows.data_description: Member card, book, loan, and return details

data_flows.name: update loan record
data_flows.description: Desk staff use the circulation page served by the lending API to extend loans, clear account blocks, and mark books returned.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand, through a circulation page the lending API serves.
data_flows.notes: The circulation page uses one shared desk login. The page does not ask again, and its history records only that the loan was closed by hand.
data_flows.data_description: Member account, loan, block, and return changes

data_flows.name: read write loan records
data_flows.description: The lending API reads and writes the loans database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API is the only thing that reads or writes it.
data_flows.data_description: Member, loan, reservation, borrowing history, and account records

trust_boundaries.name: Branch network
trust_boundaries.description: The network on which branch self-service kiosks and desk staff work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The kiosks sit on the branch network.

trust_boundaries.name: Council data centre
trust_boundaries.description: The council data-centre zone where the lending API and loans database run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The lending API and the loans database run in the council data centre.

trust_boundaries.name: Internet
trust_boundaries.description: The internet through which phones reach the lending API.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet.

assumptions.assumption: The loans database is confidential because it contains names, email addresses, home addresses, and members' full borrowing histories.
assumptions.basis: The Interview transcript explicitly states that these personal and borrowing-history records live in the loans database.
